headline: Allocated additional $3,200.00 to Town Beach party budget and $200.00 to a descendant research and grave marking project.
summary: The committee approved the June 3, 2026 minutes and heard reports on events including the Speaker Series, Military History Recognition, and Town Beach celebration, with no action taken on those items. Members voted to add $3,200.00 to the Town Beach party budget and approved $200.00 for a descendant project involving research and grave marking, which passed 4-3.
decisions: Approved allocating an additional $3,200.00 to the Town Beach party budget, unanimously.
Approved allocating $200.00 to a descendant project involving researching and grave marking, 4-3.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Stedman moved to approve the June 3, 2026 minutes. Mr. DiNoto seconded the motion, which passed unanimously.
Ms. Henderson motioned to allocate an additional $3,200.00 to the Town Beach party budget. Ms. Stedman seconded the motion, which passed unanimously.

Ms. Henderson motioned that $200.00 be allocated to a descendant project, involving researching and grave marking. Ms. Stedman seconded the motion. Four members voted in favor (Mr. DiNoto, Ms. Henderson, Ms. Nippo, Ms. Stedman); three members were opposed (Ms. Brady, Mr. Phillips, Ms. Sullivan). The motion passed.

plain_text:
Town of South Kingstown 250th Committee 
DRAFT MEETING MINUTES 
Tuesday, July 7, 2026, 5:00 p.m. – Neighborhood Guild (in person and livestream) 
 
1. ROLL CALL 
 
Present:  Nadine Brady, Emily Brennan, Russell DiNoto, Sharon Henderson, Terry Murphy, Joan 
Nippo, Mark Phillips, Carol Stedman, Kate Sullivan 
 
Not present: Ron Bergeron, Elizabeth Berke, Karen Black, Bill Boardman, Kenny Burke, Chuck 
Carey, Joshua Carter, Kayla Carter, Raphael Champlin, Nita Christy, John Desmond, Karen 
Desmond, Zach Elias, David Gates, Fred Hazard, Allison Knight, Pierre Marrec, Gail Mathews, 
Abigail Noetzel, Stephanie Osborne, Joe “Tiger” Patrick, Rebecca Pope, John Rose, Guy Stanton, 
Mallory Stedman, Deborah Suggs, Eric Wertheimer, Wayne Young 
 
Guests: Gerry Krausse 
 
2. APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES  
 
Ms. Stedman moved to approve the June 3, 2026 minutes. Mr. DiNoto seconded the motion, 
which passed unanimously. 
 
3. CHAIR’S REPORT 
 
In Mr. Burke’s absence, the meeting was chaired by Mr. Phillips. Discussion took place with no 
action taken. 
 
4. DISCUSSION 
 
Events/Workgroups 
 
Speaker Series: Discussion took place with no action taken. 
 
Overhead banners (Purple Heart Trail): No discussion took place. As the period to install 
banners has passed, this item will be removed from future agendas.
Military History Recognition: Discussion took place with no action taken. 
 
Town Beach celebration: Discussion took place with no action taken.  
 
Budget:  Ms. Murphy provided an update on the overall budget. Ms. Henderson motioned to 
allocate an additional $3,200.00 to the Town Beach party budget. Ms. Stedman seconded the 
motion, which passed unanimously. 
 
Ms. Henderson motioned that $200.00 be allocated to a descendant project, involving 
researching and grave marking. Ms. Stedman seconded the motion. Four members voted in 
favor (Mr. DiNoto, Ms. Henderson, Ms. Nippo, Ms. Stedman); three members were opposed 
(Ms. Brady, Mr. Phillips, Ms. Sullivan). The motion passed.  
 
5. UPCOMING MEETING 
 
The next meeting is to be held Wednesday, September 9 at 5:00 pm at the Neighborhood Guild.  
 
6. ADJOURNMENT:  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 5:59 p.m.  
 
Minutes prepared by Ms. Sullivan
